_meta.description: Curated test and live demonstration scenarios for the PayPal AI Hackathon presentation.

scenarios.name: Core Jaw-Dropping Demo: Multi-Item Dorm Room Budget Optimizer
scenarios.persona: College student moving into an unfurnished dorm
scenarios.prompt: I’m a college student moving into an unfurnished dorm with a strict $150 total budget. I need a desk lamp, a portable steamer, and noise-cancelling study buds. Prioritize reliability and explain compromises.

expected_ai_output.reasoning: Selected LuminaFlex clamp lamp ($29.99, 9.2/10 reliability) for durable metal arm and zero desk footprint; SteamGlide travel steamer ($26.50, 8.8/10 reliability) for quick 25s heat-up; and SoundPulse ANC buds ($54.99, 8.9/10 reliability) for 35dB noise attenuation suited for study halls. Total is $111.48, leaving $38.52 safety buffer under the $150 limit.
compromises_explained: LuminaFlex requires a table edge to clamp onto.
SteamGlide 120ml tank requires refilling after 2-3 shirts.
Opted for SoundPulse ($54.99) instead of Studio Pro ($95.00) because the $95 buds would push the bundle near or over limit.

items.name: LuminaFlex Clamp LED Architect Desk Lamp
SoundPulse Neo Hybrid ANC Study Earbuds

scenarios.name: Secondary Demo: Emergency Broken Laptop Replacement
scenarios.persona: Remote worker / student with broken laptop 24 hours before a major project deadline
scenarios.prompt: My work laptop died this morning and I have a project due in 48 hours. I need a reliable replacement laptop urgently. Budget is around $300-$350. Compare options and delivery times.

constraints.strict_disclaimer: No medical/legal advice, no guaranteed financing promises

expected_ai_output.reasoning: ThinkPad T490 provides full Windows 11 compatibility and 16GB RAM for multitasking, fitting comfortably inside the $350 budget at $304 total with overnight shipping.
compromises_explained: Item is certified refurbished with minor cosmetic wear.
Brand new Acer Swift 3 costs $429.00 (exceeds $350 budget).
Chromebook CX1 is $149 but cannot run desktop Windows applications.
